title: Signal: vcpkg overlay port directory
scope: A vcpkg-configuration.json file that declares an `overlay-ports` entry that replaces registry ports with local files.
limitations: It matches an `overlay-ports` entry that replaces registry ports with local files in the parsed vcpkg-configuration.json; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
fpNotes: A vcpkg-configuration.json that mentions an `overlay-ports` entry that replaces registry ports with local files in a comment, a documentation example or a template placeholder is not reported; the rule reads the parsed value that the installer acts on.
